u0: The agent has not yet picked up the key and the door is still closed, so the conditional requirement has not been triggered. It may keep moving around or pick up the key; taking the key while the door remains closed creates a pending obligation to open the door. If the door is opened after the key has been acquired, the requirement is recorded as satisfied.
u1: The key has been picked up while the door was still closed, so the obligation to open the door is now pending. The agent may still be holding the key or may have dropped it; either way, dropping it does not cancel the requirement. The door must be opened at least once, and until that happens the condition remains unsatisfied.
u2: The door has been opened at least once after the key was acquired, so the conditional requirement is satisfied. Later closing the door or dropping the key does not undo that satisfaction, and no further obligation from this requirement remains. This is not a final completion state; later observations leave the agent at this satisfied stage while the episode continues.
